name: Transform API Facets
description: Expose Facets through the Transform API for decoupled faceted search.
project_description:
Transform API Facets provides integration for the Facets module ( https://www.drupal.org/project/facets ) into Transform API ( https://www.drupal.org/project/transform_api ). 

 Features 
 
 Enable facets in Views transform 
 
 Post-Installation 
 
 Create facets for your view 
 Go to view settings 
 Under Transform Facets setting enable which facets you'd like to use 
 Notice: Only "checkboxes" facets work with transform_api_facets. Other plugins will not get displayed in JSON response and will result in a warning message. 
 
 Roadmap
